blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The provincial government of Nueva Vizcaya has documented 68 bird species thriving in its mountains, highlighting the province’s “rich biodiversity.” The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) in Cagayan Valley said the Provincial Tourism and Culture Office, together with the Wild Bird Photographers, conducted a bird census in selected areas. READ: Mindoro’s rarest bird captured on camera after nearly two decades The census was carried out in selected areas of Santa Fe, Kasibu, Dupax, Bayombong and Diadi as Nueva Vizcaya prepares for the 2027 Grey-faced Buzzard Summit, the DENR regional office said.
